name: The Sunlit Shallows
layout: Turquoise water over wide coral reefs, sandbars and shallow lagoons, sunlit to the seabed; the safe starting zone, though sandbanks can ground heavy subs.
look: Golden sunbeams in clear water, rainbow coral, great swirling schools of shimmering fish, gentle currents.
hazards: Running aground on sandbars, scraping coral, and territorial reef defenders during the midday sun.
foodWeb: Sunlight feeds phytoplankton and reef algae; plankton feeds filter feeders, algae and grasses feed grazers. These feed snapper packs, Inkdarts, Lancers and Moray Creepers, which fall to the Fin-Shark, Maw Grouper, Crab-Squid and Reef-Crusher Leviathan. The Coral-Crusher Leviathan grinds reef into sand; hermits, isopods, worms and carrion-crabs recycle every fall.
source: The Deep Design Document.pdf, The ten ecosystems (flora and fauna tables) and Featured species

fauna.name: Sunmote Copepod
fauna.description: Tiny sunlit copepod drifting in surface clouds, rising at dawn and sinking by noon.
fauna.tactics: Drifts in clouds; no defence beyond numbers.
fauna.behavior: Drifts in sunlit surface clouds; rises at dawn, sinks at noon

fauna.name: Lagoon Glimmer Krill
fauna.description: Glittering krill forming dense swarms over the lagoon floor.
fauna.tactics: Swarm scatters from thruster wash and predators.
fauna.behavior: Dense glittering swarms over lagoon floor; scatter from thruster wash

fauna.name: Reef Larva Cloud
fauna.description: Drifting clouds of coral and fish spawn released on full-moon tides.
fauna.tactics: Passive drift; sheer numbers on spawning tides.
fauna.behavior: Mass coral and fish spawn drifts on full-moon tides

fauna.name: Sandflit Mysid
fauna.description: Small mysid hovering just above sandbars.
fauna.tactics: Hovers over sandbars and dives into the sand when lit brightly.
fauna.behavior: Hovers just above sandbars; flees into sand when lit brightly

fauna.name: Pearl Comb Jellet
fauna.description: Comb jelly with shimmering rainbow comb rows, carried by tidal currents.
fauna.tactics: Drifts passively with the tide; no escape behaviour.
fauna.behavior: Rainbow comb rows shimmer; drifts passively with tidal currents

fauna.name: Turquoise Arrow-Worm
fauna.description: Transparent dart-shaped plankton predator that grabs copepods with spines.
fauna.tactics: Transparent ambusher; darts and snares copepods with grasping spines.
fauna.behavior: Transparent dart; strikes copepods with grasping spines

fauna.name: Chromis Glider
fauna.description: Small schooling reef fish grazing Solar-Carpet Algae; the main prey of Reef-Snappers.
fauna.tactics: Schools coordinate with 12 kHz lateral-line clicks; packs into bait balls when threatened.
fauna.behavior: Schools of 10-30; 12 kHz lateral-line clicks; forms bait balls when threatened

fauna.name: Sunscale Parrot-Wrasse
fauna.description: Large wrasse that crunches coral noisily and excretes white sand.

fauna.behavior: Crunches coral loudly; excretes white sand; sleeps in a mucus cocoon

fauna.name: Armored Reef-Tang
fauna.description: Armoured reef grazer whose tail scalpels cut divers who corner it.
fauna.tactics: Armoured grazer; slashes with tail scalpels when cornered.
fauna.behavior: Armored grazer; tail scalpels slash divers who corner it

fauna.name: Lagoon Spine-Urchin
fauna.description: Spiny urchin that carpets the reef flats at night.
fauna.tactics: Passive defence; spines puncture suits that touch it.
fauna.behavior: Carpets reef flats at night; spines puncture suits

fauna.name: Sandbar Sea-Hare

fauna.behavior: Beaked reef-grinder; reshapes sandbars; crushes anything in its feeding path

interactions: Barbed Reef-Snapper packs (3-5) flush Chromis Gliders out of open water toward coral crevices where Moray Creepers wait in ambush.
Chromis Gliders pack into bait balls when threatened; at the Sunken Pirate Galleon they escape snapper attacks through the broken gunports.
Glimmer Sardine bait balls draw predators to the area; Sunstripe Jack packs herd bait balls upward and strike at sunrise.
Sunreef Cleaner Shrimp run cleaning stations where nearby predators stay calm; Lagoon Manta-Wings visit them.
Sponge-Mimic Anglers pose as Crown Sponges and pick off cleaner shrimp, blennies and Chromis.
Turquoise Fin-Sharks smell blood from 300 m, circle and bump, then frenzy.

Coralfall Carrion-Crabs reach carcass falls first and claw-click to summon others; Sun-Bleach Isopods swarm falls within seconds, Brittle-Creepers strip them at night, Silt-Sieving Hermits cluster there.
Atoll Maw Groupers boom territorial calls from reef caves; Pearl Trigger-Biters fiercely guard sand nests.
The Reef-Crusher Leviathan ignores silent divers but rams the Nautilus's bow when sonar or engine noise exceeds 70 dB; echoing speargun shots in the galleon risk this.
The Coral-Crusher Leviathan grinds reef into sand and reshapes sandbars, crushing anything in its feeding path.
The galleon's gold and rusted cannons draw metal-obsessed Stalker-Hounds up from the Kelp Labyrinth to nest in the captain's quarters and hoard shiny drops.
Starving apex leviathans from deeper biomes may migrate into the Shallows when their prey is over-harvested.
